profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Dynatrace
profile.summary:
Hey there! I'm a Senior Full Stack Engineer who specializes in building high-scale applications that bridge the gap between heavy enterprise data infrastructure, modern frontends, and open-source GenAI. I focus on engineering smart, cost-effective software solutions that process billions of rows without breaking the bank on infrastructure bills.

My career has been defined by rapid internal mobility. I stepped into my current company as a data configuration team lead, quickly pivoted to architecting full-stack software assets utilizing C# (CQRS/MediatR) and Angular, and was recently tapped to help spearhead Expert AI solutions.

Rather than relying on expensive, black-box cloud APIs, I design intelligent applications leveraging local, open-source tech stacks. By combining tools like FAISS, LMDB, and n8n with custom embedding models, I build production-ready RAG architectures capable of transforming plain-text user intent into highly accurate database context.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
◉ Own full-stack features for Bindplane, an OpenTelemetry platform for managing telemetry pipelines across collector fleets (TypeScript/React, Go)
◉ Advancement of the product's AI capabilities, so customers can query, automate, and manage their telemetry collector fleet in plain language, backed by guardrails such as PII redaction and LLM-judged evaluations

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer | Data Engineering
positions.description:
Directed the end-to-end design, development, and deployment of a custom enterprise web application and data platform-owning the full stack from frontend experiences in Angular and React/Next.js to ASP.NET Core APIs, local open-source AI integrations (RAG & Model Context Protocol), and high-throughput containerized backend infrastructure handling 47B+ rows.

Key Accomplishments:

    ◉ Full-Stack & Clean Architecture: Architected a distributed data platform built on Clean Architecture patterns (CQRS/MediatR) across three distributed SAP HANA environments, ensuring strict separation of concerns and high-throughput scalability.

    ◉ Open-Source AI & RAG Engineering: Developed an AI-powered semantic search engine leveraging low-overhead open-source tools (FAISS, LMDB, and n8n workflow automation) with advanced embedding models to parse user plain text into database-relevant answers.

    ◉ Frontend Experiences: Built responsive, component-driven frontend dashboards using Angular and TypeScript (as well as React/Next.js for secondary web projects), implementing reactive state management and interactive visualizations that reduced data incident tickets by 40%.

    ◉ Intelligent Pattern Recognition: Engineered an AI-driven engine that autonomously analyzes 1,500+ database tables and 25,000+ columns, predicting quality checks with 75–100% confidence to cut manual engineering configuration times by over 80%.

    ◉ Containerization & Orchestration: Orchestrated 8,000+ concurrent batch processing jobs via Kubernetes CronJobs, managing deployments via Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines with Docker containerization and SonarQube quality gates.

Technologies:
Angular | React | Next.js | TypeScript | C# | ASP.NET Core | Python | FAISS | LMDB | n8n | RAG | Kubernetes | Docker | REST APIs | SAP HANA | Azure DevOps | CI/CD | SonarQube | Clean Architecture (CQRS/MediatR)
positions.insights: Full-Stack Web Development, Software Development and +13 skills

positions.title: Real Estate Agent
positions.description:
● Manage communications in all aspects of a transaction
● Preparing homes for sale, hold open houses, and advertise the house
● Negotiating favorable terms and price for both Buyer/Seller
● Drafting and reviewing documentation with clear communication
● Marketing homes through the local Multiple Listing Service
● Offering unique insight into the market to help with pricing
